description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class for setting up an Amazon S3 client (ContentS3Config). It includes bean configuration, conditional property-based instantiation, and AWS credentials setup for accessing S3 storage in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ContentS3Config
classes.description: Spring configuration class for Amazon S3 client setup, incorporating credential configuration and optional region and endpoint customization based on application properties.

methods.name: contentS3Client
methods.description: Defines a Spring-managed S3Client bean, configured with credentials, region, and endpoint override based on FineractProperties.

methods.name: getCredentialProvider
methods.description: Selects and returns an AWS credentials provider based on the given S3 properties, defaulting to the default credentials provider if access key or secret key are missing.
